description: Check whether a specific AI tool is free and exactly what its free plan includes: limits, catches, how to get it free, the cheapest paid plan and when it was last checked. Accepts a tool name ('ChatGPT', 'Midjourney') or website ('canva.com'). If the tool isn't free, says why and suggests free alternatives. Each tool comes with a link to its Free AI For That page, which has the dated source and the full free-plan details.
name: check_free_plan
title: Is this AI tool free?
